meta.title: Yuelong (John) Guo — Computational Biology, Education & Community
meta.description: Yuelong (John) Guo is a bioinformatics scientist working across biomarker discovery, quantitative imaging, and large-scale human genomics, and a volunteer curriculum designer and community leader in North Carolina.

profile.name: Yuelong (John) Guo
profile.role: I work at the point where biological measurement becomes evidence — quantitative imaging, proteomic biomarkers, and human genetics at population scale.
profile.introduction: A publication record spanning genetics, transfusion medicine, oncology, and neurodegeneration — alongside volunteer curriculum design and leadership across North Carolina's science, technology, and education communities.

research.title: Histology imaging
research.summary: Turning stained tissue sections into measurements: segmentation, morphometry, and reproducible quantification of structures that pathologists read qualitatively.

research.title: PD proteomics & biomarkers
research.summary: Plasma and tissue proteomics for Parkinson's disease and related neurodegeneration — biomarker discovery, patient stratification, and model systems that make the biology tractable.

research.title: Blood systems genomics
research.summary: The largest thread in the record: donor genetics, red blood cell storage biology, and hemolysis across a multi-ancestry cohort of more than 13,000 blood donors.

research.title: Statistical genetics & GWAS
research.summary: Genome-wide association studies across European and African-American ancestries, plus method evaluation for integrating biological function with GWAS summary statistics.

research.title: Sickle cell disease cohorts
research.summary: Clinical and genetic ancestry profiling in a large multi-centre Brazilian sickle cell disease cohort, and the genetic predictors of its complications.

research.title: Oncology pharmacogenomics
research.summary: Pediatric Preclinical Testing Consortium evaluations of targeted agents in childhood leukemia and solid tumours, plus immunogenomic profiling of response to checkpoint inhibitors and high-dose IL-2.

research.title: Genetical genomics
research.summary: Doctoral and early work inferring interaction networks between species — cross-species eQTL mapping of the plant–nematode symbiosis, genome annotation, and molecular phylogenetics.

about.headline: Researcher. Course builder. Community organizer.
paragraphs: My research career has moved from plant and nematode genomes to human population genetics, from transfusion medicine to neurodegeneration. The through-line is method rather than organism: define the measurement carefully, respect what the data can and cannot support, and make the analysis reproducible by someone else.

The same instinct shows up outside the lab. Designing a course means deciding what a learner should be able to do at the end and building the shortest honest path there. Running a volunteer organization means the same work applied to people and process instead of data.
This site is built to grow with the work: research themes can expand into methods and outcomes, courses into curricula and learner results, and service roles into documented initiatives.
